verses.10: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.13: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.14: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.15: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.16: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.18: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.19: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.20: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.21: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.22: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.23: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
